name: Spondylodysplastic Dysplasia

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Radiological Diagnostic Criteria for Spondylodysplastic Dysplasia

criteria.description: Presence of disproportionate short stature with short limbs
Radiological evidence of platyspondyly (flattened vertebral bodies)
Characteristic pelvic bone dysplasia on imaging
Clinical finding of mild joint hypermobility

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of disproportionate short stature with short limbs plus radiological evidence of platyspondyly and pelvic dysplasia
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical supported by characteristic radiological findings; genetic testing may assist but is not always definitive.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Disproportionate short stature with short limbs
searchTerms: short stature with disproportionately short limbs
disproportionate short height due to limb shortening

pathognomonic.symptomName: Platyspondyly (flattened vertebral bodies) on spinal imaging
Pelvic bone dysplasia evident on radiographs

common.symptomName: Gait abnormalities due to skeletal deformities
searchTerms: abnormal gait due to skeletal issues
difficulty walking caused by bone shape

occasional.symptomName: Joint pain secondary to skeletal abnormalities
searchTerms: painful joints related to bone issues

occasional.symptomName: Mild respiratory compromise due to thoracic cage abnormalities
searchTerms: mild respiratory issues due to rib cage
back pain with nerve compression signs
weakness or numbness from spinal cord squeezing

imaging: Pelvic bone dysplasia on pelvic radiographs
Mild scoliosis or kyphosis on spinal imaging
genetic: Mutations in genes related to skeletal development (e.g., SLC26A2 mutations reported in some cases)
other: Normal cognitive function despite skeletal abnormalities

distinguishingFeatures: Characteristic facial features (frontal bossing, midface hypoplasia)

redFlags: Progressive neurological deficits indicating spinal cord compression
Severe respiratory compromise due to thoracic cage deformity
Rapidly worsening skeletal deformities impairing mobility
references: Superti-Furga A, Unger S. Nosology and classification of genetic skeletal disorders: 2019 revision. Am J Med Genet A. 2019.
Warman ML, Cormier-Daire V, Hall C, et al. Nosology and classification of genetic skeletal disorders: 2010 revision. Am J Med Genet A. 2011.
